items.headline: Rip Current Statement issued October 4 at 10:56PM CDT until October 5 at 7:00PM CDT by NWS Mobile AL
items.description:
* WHAT...Dangerous rip currents.

* WHERE...In Alabama, Mobile Coastal and Baldwin Coastal
Counties. In Florida, Escambia Coastal, Santa Rosa Coastal and
Okaloosa Coastal Counties.

* WHEN...Through Monday evening.

* IMPACTS...Rip currents can sweep even the best swimmers away
from shore into deeper water.
items.instruction:
Swim near a lifeguard. If caught in a rip current, relax and
float. Don't swim against the current. If able, swim in a
direction following the shoreline. If unable to escape, face the
shore and call or wave for help.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 5 at 5:41PM CDT until October 9 at 3:00AM CDT by NWS Mobile AL
items.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 20 to 25 kt with gusts up to 30 kt and
seas 4 to 7 ft expected.

* WHERE...Coastal waters from Okaloosa Walton County Line FL to
Pascagoula MS out to 60 NM.

* WHEN...From 6 AM Tuesday to 3 AM CDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
